name: partner-order-intake-preparation
executionConcern: partner order intake, decision, preparation, cancellation issue handling and canonical lifecycle readback before custody transfer
objective: Close the Partner order workboard from actor-scoped read through legal accept/reject/preparation actions to canonical DSH read-after-write state, preserving client/operator readback and preventing local optimistic order truth.
truthOwner: DSH order domain and PostgreSQL state machine; WLT only for financial consequences initiated by separate governed operations.

tasks.objective: Close Partner order state transitions at DSH truth owner
tasks.currentProblem: Server-backed reads and static guards do not prove every command, DB transition, retry and readback is aligned.
tasks.requiredChange: Trace each Partner order command through contract, authorization, DSH state machine, persistence/idempotency/audit and read-after-write; correct the first divergence.
tasks.targetState: Owned-Store orders alone can move through legal transitions and every successful command returns canonical committed state.
tasks.action: Implement at DSH owner first, migrate affected Partner/client/operator consumers, remove obsolete local behavior, then rerun linked checks.
mustNotChange: Do not create local final order state.
Do not let Partner mutate another Store order.
Do not couple operational order truth to WLT tables.
Do not change Captain custody rules in this unit.
acceptanceCriteria: Every protected mutation proves Partner/Store/order ownership.
Retries do not duplicate effects and stale transitions fail explicitly.
tasks.rollback: Revert focused order changes or roll forward at DSH owner without restoring local final truth.
tasks.commitBoundary: One focused U002 commit after DSH owner correction and affected readback migration.

tasks.objective: Close Partner order negative/recovery states across affected consumers
tasks.currentProblem: A successful Partner screen alone cannot prove customer/operator state or denial/conflict recovery.
tasks.requiredChange: Align loading, empty, offline, forbidden, conflict, error and recovery states to canonical order results and remove stale compatibility fallbacks.
tasks.targetState: All affected consumers display the same committed order lifecycle and no surface reports success before readback.
tasks.action: Change only proven order consumers and preserve unrelated client/operator capabilities.
mustNotChange: Do not hide canonical conflict/forbidden errors.
Do not retain optimistic final state.
tasks.rollback: Revert consumer-only changes while keeping canonical DSH owner semantics.
